_comment: Citations and external identifiers that the published documents refer to.
This file exists so that a number appearing in a document -- an upstream
issue number, a spec version -- has a committed source like every other
number. Nothing here is a measurement; measurements live in manifests and
run outputs. Each entry records where it was read and when.

gdn_batch_invariant.title: Batch invariance not supported for GDN_ATTN
gdn_batch_invariant.why_it_matters: vLLM raises RuntimeError when VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 is set on a Gated DeltaNet attention model, so byte-reproducible greedy decoding is unavailable on Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 class architectures

fused_moe_batch_invariant.title: Batch invariance not supported for fused MoE
fused_moe_batch_invariant.why_it_matters: the same flag is refused for fused mixture-of-experts kernels, which rules out the MoE variants of several current candidates

model.note: release date of the Qwen2.5 instruct series as published on the model card; the training data cutoff is not documented by the publisher

p2_1.reason: P2.1 recalibration was requested and has not run. The dataset specification states the threshold and the defect in its evidence plainly rather than waiting.

seed2.note: second-seed replication of Cond-1 and Cond-2 was launched on the DGX and had not finished when these documents were built; the findings state the single-seed limitation in the finding itself

engineering_rules._comment: rule numbers as they appear in docs/engineering-rules.md; cited by the generated documents so the citation itself is traceable

gates._comment: gate numbers as used across the phase reports; cited by the generated documents
